title: The pairwise Stone space of an S4 De Morgan algebra
summary: The purpose of this study is to investigate the bitopological duality theory of De Morgan algebras equipped with a closure operator, known as S4 De Morgan algebras. We first introduce certain expansions of pairwise Stone spaces, which we call pairwise S4 De Morgan Stone spaces (henceforth, PS4D-spaces). These consist of a pairwise Stone space $X$ equipped with a twist continuous involution $g\colon X\to X$, as well as a binary relation $R\subseteq X\times X$ that is reflexive and transitive.
